name: WARRIOR
description: Steel and fire. The warrior forges victory from the anvil of battle.
blurb: Tempered in the forge-fires of Emberhold, warriors carry the ancient craft of war into every fight.

name: NECROMANCER
description: Bone and bargain. The necromancer commands what others fear to wake.
blurb: In the ossuary-veils of Palewatch, the dead do not rest — they serve.

name: DRUID
description: Root and renewal. The druid speaks the language of the living earth.
blurb: Deep in the canopies of Mossgrave, druids tend the old growth and awaken the deep roots.

name: TIDECALLER
description: Depth and current. The tidecaller reads the drowned archives of the ocean.
blurb: Beneath the salt-spires of Brinehollow, tidecallers coax forgotten knowledge from the deep.

name: DAWNWARD
description: Light and covenant. The dawnward stands at first light against the shadow.
blurb: In the golden halls of Aurelan, dawnwards take up the radiance of the first morning.

name: RANGER
description: Wilds and first light. The ranger walks where dawn meets the deep wood.
blurb: From the treeline settlements of Thornfield, rangers guard the border between shadow and sunrise.

name: OCCULTIST
description: Drowned truth and veiled power. The occultist speaks what the deep has swallowed.
blurb: In the fog-choked meres of Mirefen, occultists bargain with things that should have stayed drowned.
